title: Core normalized scalar transition through reduction and limit
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-pod-reindexing-tensor-coefficient-transition, construct a PodReindexCoefficientTransition whose pure-tensor, reduction, and normalized limit squares satisfy their displayed Laws clauses.

proof.text: Use the finite-free scalar extension comparison on the actual quotient systems. Balanced tensor associativity fixes the pure-tensor map and its inverse. Descend the same strict-system map through the normalized Roos realization; its counit formulas give the reduction and limit squares. The completed tensor square is isolated as the next proof step.

proof_origin.place: Steps 1 and 5; split before the completed tensor square

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorCoefficientTransition_core
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L)
    (D' : PodCompletionReindex l L g) (hD' : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l L g D')
    (T' : PodCompletedTensorReindex l L g D')
    (hT' : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l L g D' T') :
    ∃ S : PodReindexCoefficientTransition l E L ι g D D',
      PodReindexCoefficientTransition.Core l E g L ι D D' S
